title: Junta Artillery and Airstrikes Escorting Ayeyarwady Supply Flotilla Kill Civilians in Kachin, Sagaing Villages
detail: Between August 23-24, 2026, junta artillery units shelled Kyuntaw, a riverside village near Shwegu Town in Kachin State, killing four civilians including a young child, as SAC forces bombarded riverbanks to clear a path for a 14-15 vessel supply flotilla carrying weapons, ammunition, and provisions from Mandalay toward Kachin State. Concurrent airstrikes targeted Kalon village on the Katha-Tigyaing border and Kamphyu village in Wetlet Township, leaving one civilian dead and two injured, while a monastery chapel in Shwegu's Sithaw village was destroyed. A resident of the Katha-Shwegu border area said aircraft had been "bombing riverside villages almost continuously" since the flotilla set out, even striking pagodas. The flotilla, which departed Mandalay around August 21, docked in Katha Town on the evening of August 25 after days of continuous escort bombardment.

media.caption: Junta airstrikes and artillery escort a supply flotilla up the Ayeyarwady River, killing civilians in riverside villages.
